The '''Squab system''' was located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the primary star [[Squab]]<ref name="GG" /> and the planet [[Skor II]].<ref name="LF" />
